items.title: Ray Shiner interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, October 11, 1998
items.q: And the guy accompanying me on that bit was the marimba player, who was an original member of the Sauter-Finegan band, Walter Rosenberger.

ctx.x: So that kind of stopped the conversation. And the guy accompanying me on that bit was the marimba player, who was an original member of the Sauter-Finegan band, Walter Rosenberger. So Walter played the marimba and I played the alto sax and that was it. Bernstein came in a month later to record it. And he just said, “Is my sax player here?” And I says, “Yeah, right here.” “Is my trumpet player here?” And Gino says, “He’s here.” So we were the two outside men from the New York Philharmonic.
